description: Implementation of resource grid writer functions for 5G NR PHY layer, including methods for writing symbols and subcarriers into a resource grid data structure.

classes.name: resource_grid_writer_impl
classes.description: Class implementing methods to write symbols and subcarriers into a resource grid for 5G NR PHY.

methods.name: get_nof_ports
methods.description: Returns the number of ports in the resource grid.

methods.name: get_nof_subc
methods.description: Returns the number of subcarriers in the resource grid.

methods.name: get_nof_symbols
methods.description: Returns the number of symbols in the resource grid.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Writes symbols or subcarriers into the resource grid at specified position, with overloads for different data types and parameters.

methods.name: get_view
methods.description: Provides a view into the resource grid data for a specific port and symbol index.
